# Open question: [Specific unresolved decision]

> **Use:** Capture one material unresolved choice only when no existing authoritative decision record covers it. Do not invent an owner, review date or an approval. Keep the answer explicitly pending until evidence of a real decision exists.

- **Decision status:** Open
- **Authority and review date (if known):** [Verified source or omit]

## Decision needed

[State the exact unknown and what behavior or architecture depends on it.]

## Known facts and constraints

[Include established requirements and evidence; link authoritative sources.]

## Options and implications

[Include only considered alternatives and known tradeoffs.]

## Resolution

**Decision status:** Pending.

[Once the responsible authority actually decides, record the confirmed answer, evidence and decision date. A question document may contain an accepted decision; its filename alone does not mean it is still open. Keep a separate list of any remaining unresolved implementation details. Do not call a statement accepted simply because it appears in historical notes.]

## Affected documents and follow-through (when applicable)

[Link existing sources that need an update after resolution; record only real changes and verification evidence. A decision being written down does not prove implementation.]
